_comment: Rules are keyed on sorted TAG pairs, never part IDs. PROJECTILE is a STRUCTURAL tag -- it exists so weapons can ban it -- and deliberately carries no interaction rules, because it sits on almost every muzzle part.

combos.name: Flock
combos.effect: Each fork independently seeks. Terrifying, low per-hit damage.

combos.name: Fractal
combos.effect: Forks fork. Exponential count, tiny damage each. A cloud of dots.

combos.name: Rake
combos.effect: A parallel comb of lines that all penetrate.

combos.name: Cat's Cradle
combos.effect: The line bounces and continues, stitching a whole room together.

combos.name: Redaction
combos.effect: Erases a tunnel clean through level geometry. Permanently changes the map.

combos.name: Wash
combos.effect: Wide short-range zone paint. Denies a corridor outright.

combos.name: Scribble
combos.effect: Wild inaccuracy, doubled fire rate. Deeply stupid, occasionally correct.

combos.name: Siphon Pool
combos.effect: Your ink pools drain pocket ink from enemies standing in them.

combos.name: Crumple Guard
combos.effect: Damage taken randomised ×0.3–1.7. Gambling with your life.

combos.name: Guided Hand
combos.effect: Your shots seek anything you've marked, through anything.

combos.name: Bounty
combos.effect: Marked enemies drop +50% Blots on death. The support player's jackpot.

combos.name: Rub Out
combos.effect: A wide erase cone. Strips parts off everyone in front of you.

combos.name: Surgical Erasure
combos.effect: Strips one specific chosen part instead of a random one.

combos.name: Ruled Line
combos.effect: Perfectly straight infinite-range hitscan. Heavy damage, long recovery.

combos.name: Splatterball
combos.effect: Bouncing blob that splashes on every bounce.

combos.name: Bent Staple
combos.effect: Staples curve. Ink-free tracking for the broke player.

combos.name: Stapled Plating
combos.effect: Flat damage reduction, and it cannot be erased.

combos.name: Total Nonsense
combos.effect: Every shot picks a random other combo's behaviour for that shot.

combos.name: Buckshot
combos.effect: The spread divides again on the way out. Twice the dots, half the weight.

combos.name: Leech Line
combos.effect: The line siphons a trickle of pocket ink from everyone it passes through.

combos.name: Registration Marks
combos.effect: Marked targets show a lead indicator and take +15% from you.

combos.name: Blast Shield
combos.effect: Your own area effects no longer hurt you, and push enemies back.

bleeds.name: Indecision
bleeds.effect: Both want to steer. Shots wander, curve back, occasionally hit you.

bleeds.name: Shaky Hand
bleeds.effect: A scope drawn on a gun that can't hold still. Zoomed and inaccurate.

bleeds.name: Thin Blast
bleeds.effect: The blast wants to spread, the pierce wants a line. Both get weaker.

bleeds.name: Self-Erasing
bleeds.effect: Your eraser eats your own plating. Armour decays while you shoot.

bleeds.name: Wobble
bleeds.effect: Precision and chaos cancel. You get neither, and the sight drifts.

bleeds.name: Blunt Instrument
bleeds.effect: Staples won't hold a highlighter mark. It rubs off in seconds.

thirst_floor_by_tier._comment: Multiplier alone is not enough: a Masterpiece assembled from cheap media (Pencil + Highlighter + Pen) came out at 2.7/shot, which is sustainable all match and defeats 'burst power, not sustained power'. The floor sets the minimum cost of running an interaction at all, regardless of what it's drawn with.
